items.stem: Copilot in Word returns a confident paragraph citing a statistic. Before using it in a client proposal, what must happen?

options.text: The statistic is verified against a trusted source
options.rationale: Correct: Copilot output can be wrong, so externally reported figures must be verified.

options.text: The paragraph is accepted because Copilot sounds confident
options.rationale: Confident phrasing is not evidence of accuracy.

options.text: The document is simply made longer
The figure is left unchecked because it was AI-generated
options.rationale: AI generation is a reason to verify, not to skip verification.

items.explanation: Correct: Copilot output can be wrong, so externally reported figures must be verified.

items.stem: Which TWO statements about Microsoft 365 Copilot grounding and permissions are correct? (Select TWO.)

options.text: Copilot trims results to content the signed-in user can already access
options.rationale: Correct: permission trimming means Copilot cannot surface files the user lacks access to.

options.text: Grounding can pull relevant organizational context into a prompt
options.rationale: Correct: grounding brings in relevant tenant data the user is permitted to see.

options.text: Grounding guarantees every generated sentence is factually correct
options.rationale: Grounding improves relevance but does not guarantee correctness.

options.text: Copilot ignores sensitivity labels on documents
options.rationale: Copilot honours sensitivity labels and their protection settings.

items.explanation: Correct: permission trimming means Copilot cannot surface files the user lacks access to.

items.stem: Which task is least appropriate to fully delegate to Copilot in Word without review?

options.text: Final sign-off that a contract clause is legally correct
options.rationale: Correct: legal correctness requires qualified human judgement, not unreviewed AI output.

options.text: Producing a first draft of a summary
options.rationale: Drafting is a reasonable assisted task when reviewed.

options.text: Suggesting a clearer phrasing of a sentence
options.rationale: Rephrasing suggestions are a reasonable assisted task.

options.text: Generating an outline to react to
options.rationale: Outlining is a reasonable assisted task.
